payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute dp[i] = product_{j=0}^{i-1} (2^j+1), then for each bit i where 2^i ≤ d, add dp[i] * count of numbers with MSB i (up to d). This counts sequences by choosing at most one number per increasing MSB group.
payload.rationale: Solution transforms XOR increasing constraint into MSB grouping; no actual XOR operations appear. Code relies on binary ranges to compute choices, fitting bit_binary_representation cleanly.
